articles.title: $M^3$: A Multi-LLM System for Multi-Turn Jailbreaking as a Markov Decision Process

articles.title: TACS-RF: Tool-driven Agentic Circuit Synthesis of RF and mmWave Modules
articles.title_zh: TACS-RF: Tool-driven Agentic Circuit Synthesis of RF and mmWave Modules
articles.description:
arXiv:2610.31882v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We present the framework of TACS-RF - a Tool-driven Agentic Circuit Synthesis of RF and mmWave modules. In this framework, a large-language-model (LLM) coding agent (Claude Opus 4.8) directly drives industry-standard electronic-design-automation (EDA) tools such as Cadence Virtuoso/Spectre, Calibre, Cadence EMX, and Ansys HFSS to design RF and mmWave modules. We validate the framework through the agentic design of a 240-251 GHz sub-THz transmitter

articles.title: Patronizing and Condescending Language Detection in English and Mandarin

articles.description:
arXiv:2610.31808v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Patronizing and condescending language (PCL) is a form of harmful language that belittles and assumes pity for vulnerable groups, reinforcing negative societal stereotypes.
